summary: Minimal, idiomatic __getstate__/__setstate__ that mirrors matplotlib's established pickling pattern (same as Figure/other artists) and resolves the unpicklable-canvas chain through the draggable legend. Correct approach, matches repo conventions, no regression or compatibility break.

issues.description: After unpickling, self.legend is permanently None, so the DraggableLegend loses its back-reference and drag behavior is not restored (user must call set_draggable again). Acceptable known limitation for pickle support, not a merge blocker.

Comment 'Remove the unpicklable entries' is slightly imprecise — it nulls the legend reference to break the path to the unpicklable canvas rather than removing an inherently unpicklable object; a one-line note on why would aid future readers.
